usage.callShape: GET https://kg.dyor.network/api/search?query={query}&limit={n} (query string params; x402 payment on Base)
quirks: GET endpoint — params go in the query string, not a JSON body (query is required; optional limit, entity_types).
usage.guide: Call GET https://kg.dyor.network/api/search with a required `query` query-string param (entity name or semantic search query), optional `limit` (default 10) and `entity_types[]` filter (Token, Protocol, Chain, Organization, Person, Exchange, Pool). Pay $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base. The response is a plain synchronous JSON object; read the matched entities from body.results[], each having uri, name, similarity, and a description.
